breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It correctly calculated the Reynolds number (Re_x = 2,000,000), which is in the turbulent regime. However, instead of identifying this and using a turbulent correlation as the ground truth does, it proceeded to follow the user's incorrect instruction to use the laminar boundary-layer formula (δ = 5 x / sqrt(Re_x)). The core error of applying a laminar formula to a turbulent flow was not corrected.
